summary: Independent verification of the founder-approved change making phone OPTIONAL on signup + new /auth/update-phone endpoint + Settings > Profile phone card + Admin user-detail phone line. Both backend (pytest, 11/11 pass against preview API) and frontend (Playwright against the preview URL) were tested. No regression found on the existing signup/login flow when phone is not touched. Admin Users LIST table is unchanged (still 9 th cells: empty-checkbox, EMAIL, NAME, TIER, PROJECTS, TASKS, STATUS, JOINED, empty-actions — no 9th 'Phone' column added). Admin user detail card shows the phone line with em-dash fallback when the user has no phone.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py _validate_phone_optional() correctly uses phonenumbers.parse + is_valid_number — not a regex. Empty/None short-circuits to None (no false rejection). E.164 normalization confirmed end-to-end via /auth/me.

POST /auth/update-phone properly enforces JWT (returns 401/403 without a token), reuses the same _validate_phone_optional() helper, and preserves the previous phone when the new input is invalid (verified because it 400s BEFORE the $set update — good).

PhoneNumberCard.jsx sends `null` when the input is blank (line 29 `phone: trimmed || null`), which matches the backend clear-behavior. Client-side isValidPhoneNumber() also runs first so invalid input is caught before the API call.
Admin.jsx line 708 shows the phone in the detail card only; Users list table verified untouched (9 th cells unchanged).

Minor nit (non-blocking): PhoneNumberCard.jsx keeps stale `ok` state visible after a successful clear — visually acceptable but a subsequent invalid submission would still hide it via `setOk(false)` at top of submit(), so this is fine.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of throwaway signup users on the preview DB with emails matching phone-qa-*@aurem.dev (blank / valid / update-flow variants). dev_users has no automated cleanup — safe to ignore, or purge with an email-prefix filter later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file test_optional_phone_signup_2026_01.py is idempotent (generates unique emails per run) and can be re-run any time. Note: /auth/me returns the user object nested under `user` key, NOT top-level — that's the shape used throughout the codebase.
verified_features: Signup with phone key absent -> 200, phone stored as null
Signup with phone='' -> 200, phone stored as null
Signup with valid phone '+14155552671' -> 200, /auth/me returns E.164
Signup with 'abc123' -> 400 with helpful message; login for same email returns 401 (no account leaked through)
Login regression: test@aurem.dev logs in successfully
POST /auth/update-phone changes to another valid number persists
POST /auth/update-phone invalid -> 400 and previous value preserved
POST /auth/update-phone with null clears the field

UI: /settings?tab=profile renders settings-phone card; invalid input surfaces inline error via settings-phone-error and does NOT clear the input; valid submit shows settings-phone-success; blank submit clears successfully
UI: /admin/users -> search -> view opens UserDetail with data-testid='admin-user-phone' showing '—' when no phone (verified against a fresh phone-qa signup)
UI: /admin/users LIST table has 9 th cells (unchanged from prior) — no new Phone column
